Yes! Just enter spaces in the name field, and we will print the design only.

What age group is this name label pouch for?

It works for kids of all ages, especially school and daycare, since it keeps their name labels tidy and easy to find.

Does it fit inside your range of school bags?

Definitely! It slides right into our school bags with plenty of space left for books, lunch bags, and other supplies.

description.html:
This personalised kids name label pouch makes organisation a breeze for busy families. Each pouch is designed to neatly store Name Labels, so you can keep every child’s labels in one place. Ordering labels for more than one kid? Give them each a pouch and say goodbye to the chaos.

Pick from loads of bright, fun designs and personalise with your child’s name to make it extra special. You can even match it with the rest of their school supplies for a complete set.

Made from tough, machine-washable fabric, this pouch is built to handle daily use and still look great. While it is perfect for storing kids name labels, it is also super handy for travel, medicines, or everyday essentials.

Pouch Size: 25cm wide x 16cm high (9.8" x 6.2”)

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation field will be printed, so double-check spelling before placing your order.
